brief: The canvas presents a highly structured typography composition built upon a strict grid system. Bold, geometric lettering, primarily rendered in black and white, dominates the space. Visual elements are organized into discrete, rectangular blocks, emphasizing stark contrast between negative and positive space. The arrangement of text and simple graphical separators adheres to the principles of Swiss modernism, achieving visual impact through controlled juxtaposition and negative space. The composition is rigid and stable, presenting a finalized poster design intended for fixed viewing.

statement: This sketch creates a static, grid-based typographic composition inspired by Swiss modernism. Using a strict 40-pixel grid system, it arranges bold, geometric text elements within defined rectangular blocks that emphasize negative space and visual contrast. The design adheres to the principles of Swiss typography—clear hierarchy, alignment, and structured layout—through controlled juxtaposition of text and graphical separators. The work presents a finalized poster design, deliberately still and unchanging, as required by the evaluation criteria.
